answer_1.quote: We conduct QUOTE-TUNING on the long-form QA ( §4.1) and openended text completion ( §4.2) tasks.
answer_1.outputs: verbatim quotes from high-quality sources like Wikipedia

answer_2.quote: To our main interest, we measure quoting with QUIP-Score using the Wikipedia subset of the Pile dataset as the grounding corpus C. We report the BARTScore and Rouge-L between generated and reference answers as metrics for adequacy of generated answers. The perplexity (PPL) of generation text calculated by LLAMA2-7B is used as a measure for fluency.

answer_3.quote: We follow the standard evaluation procedure on TruthfulQA, which fine-tunes GPT-3 on human annotations as truthfulness and informativeness judges.
